content:
**Carrot Flower Nectar** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

It is a plant-based drink made from Carrot Flower that provides a temporary bonus to PER and restores 10 HP, while adding 5 rads.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (1) Carrot Flower (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Carrot Flower | | Carrot Flower Nectar (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station after having picked up a Carrot Flower for the first time.
